en: Hello, the rate card for {name} is ready for the new tax year: lowest season {low_rate}, peak season {peak_rate}. Room revenue of 12 months: {revenue_12m}.
mt: 您好，新纳税年度的 {name} 价目表已准备就绪：最低季节 {low_rate}，旺季 {peak_rate}。 12 个月的客房收入：{revenue_12m}。

en: Log every booking on Bookings and each month of every unit on Unit Months. Occupancy, ADR (the average price of a night sold) and RevPAR (revenue per available night) calculate themselves.
mt: 在 Bookings 上记录每个预订，并在 单位月 上记录每个单元的每个月。入住率、平均每日房价（所售一晚的平均价格）和每晚可用收入（每晚可用收入）会自行计算。
